newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Rebhold offer fully subscribed, to list Wed.
newsitem.headline: Rebhold offer fully subscribed, to list Wed.

text.p: South African liquor, food and freight forwarding company, Rebhold Ltd said on Wednesday a private placing of 23-million shares had been fully subscribed.
The group, which will be listed in the beverages, hotels and leisure sector of the Johannesburg Stock Exchange on Wednesday, said the shares were issued at a price of 220 cents each.

Rebhold said earnings are forecast to grow by at least 20 percent to 20.5 cents a share in the year to end-June 1997 from 17.1 cents the year in 1996. The company intends to adopt a dividend policy of 3.3 times cover.
Rebhold said earlier this week the listing will raise 50 million rand which will be used to eliminate debt and to fund future acquisitions.
The company, which was originally formed out of the merger of liquor groups Picardi and Rebel, will have have an initial market capitalisation of 264 million rand.
